summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat's Sporting Notes carried a notice for Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, offering a free concert every evening with the best singers.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, July 4, 1896.

facts.fact: Allen advertised his saloon at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, as "retired champion pugilist of the world," offering a free concert every evening with "best of singers only"

notes: Recurring paid-style Sporting Notes notice for Allen's saloon (same text ran 1896-06-20, 06-27, 07-04, 07-11, 09-19). The item is solely about Allen, so focus primary.
